title: The Straits Impregnable
author: Sydney Loch
current_text: In 1916, the military censor in Australia banned the second edition of The Straits Impregnable under regulations of the War Precautions Act 1914, and all copies of that edition were pulped.

sources.quote: A second edition was printed shortly after the first but this time with a note in the cover that stated "This book, Written in Australia, Egypt and Gallipoli, Is true". This time the censor was aware that the book was in fact true and banned the book, all 2nd edition copies being pulped.
